_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

datasets.basis: datasets SPACER was applied across, the release's count, the abstract's too (c20)

benchmark_low.basis: the low end of the benchmark range, four times more effective, the release's word parsed to a number

benchmark_high.basis: the high end of the benchmark range, 21 times more effective

published_day.basis: day of October the journal published the article

published_year.basis: year the journal published the article

cancer_types_mucin.basis: cancer types the mucin association names: melanoma, gastric

named_uses.basis: settings beyond cancer the release names as possible uses: autoimmune disorders, tissue repair, wound healing

funders.basis: funders the release names: the National Institutes of Health; the Cancer Prevention and Research Institute of Texas; the U.S. Department of Defense; the Adrienne Helis Malvin Medical Research Foundation; a Baylor College of Medicine Department of Surgery Seed Grant
